product_metadata.title: Engilen Fairy Lights 7.2 Feet 20 LED Copper Wire String Lights with Button Battery Operated for DIY Home Vase Jar Christmas Mother's Day Hoilday Party Multicolor (6 Pack)
features: Pack of 6 units: 6 pack LED Fairy String lights are mainly made of high quality 6.6ft long flexible silver coated copper wires, with 20 Micro LED Beads. Please note, 2 x CR2032 batteries per lights and a screwdriver included, 48 Hours of battery life. Batteries need to be replaced when the lights get dim.

Safe & Save Energy: 2x CR2032 batteries per string included, which support 48 hours continuous working and longer if using with breaks. The Starry Moon Lights are extremely low power and insulates heat. They are safe to touch. The soft lights can also protect your eyes.

Flexible Copper Wire(silver coated): 6.6feet/2m extra thin string with bright high quality 20pcs micro starry LED fairy lights, 7.87in/20cm cable between the battery case and the first LED, could be bent into any shape, flexible for LED DIY Decor

Widely Used: Flexible and thin but sturdily built, the fairy lights string can be easily bent, 360 degrees sparkle with beautiful effect, perfect to use as wedding centerpiece, or decorate party, Christmas, shop, restaurant and kid's room, anywhere indoor or outdoor usage of lighting decorations and projects & crafts
What You Get: 6 set of LED Fairy String Light, 2x CR2032 batteries per lights, 1x User Manual, 1x Screw Driver for replacing batteries.
